Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Oris Wyror: 31-year-old man, 180 cm (tall), exceptional bodybuilder construction with enormous but coherent human muscle mass, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: soft rectangular face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: wrapped contrasting band. Wardrobe: quilted-outerwear, specifically lightly quilted cloth outerwear over a simple fitted layer and tapered trousers; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette rust-charcoal. Visible personal details: an extensive but nonmagical geometric tattoo language across both arms. Make body construction and habitual posture the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
